name: AstroScaper
detailed_description:
AstroScaper is a minimalist puzzle city-builder where every placement counts. Build colonies on asteroids using strategic proximity-based mechanics and minimal resource management. Relax in freebuild mode or chase high scores in challenge mode – all against a serene cosmic backdrop.


AstroScaper is being crafted by a two-person team in early development. Heavily inspired by Islanders, the game will share a similar scope and vibe while introducing fresh ideas in a sci-fi setting.

We’re pouring our hearts into this little universe and welcome you along for the journey. Feel free to share feedback and ideas!

CHALLENGE MODE - CORE GAMEPLAY

In Challenge Mode, you'll progress through a series of asteroids, each demanding thoughtful placement of your structures. Buildings earn points based on proximity bonuses, encouraging clever arrangements and strategic thinking. There’s no rush – take your time to plan and refine your layout to maximize your score. Future seasonal leaderboards and events will offer fresh challenges and friendly competition.

FREEBUILD MODE - CASUAL CREATIVITY

Prefer to relax and just build? Freebuild Mode lets you pick any asteroid seed and create without limits or pressure. Construct a peaceful space town for the fun of it – no scores, no game-overs. Simply enjoy the meditative experience of building among the stars and grab some screenshots.

ROBUST CAMERA CONTROLS

- Orbit Mode - Keeps your colony centered while you pan and rotate.


- Focused Mode - Gives more control, allowing for close-ups and more dynamic angles.

PROCEDURALLY GENERATED ENVIRONMENTS

Every level in AstroScaper is a unique, tiny world, each offering its own layout and challenge. Enjoy soothing, stylized cosmic scenery as you navigate randomly generated environments just waiting to be filled with your creations. Try different challenges based on shareable map seeds, and take part in community-driven shared challenges that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.


Everything you see here reflects our pre-alpha development state, and we can’t wait to share more as the game evolves!
